Derek McInnes

After a three-season absence from the League Cup and the loss of European competition, Heart of Midlothian have appointed Derek McInnes as their new head coach, who is making his competitive debut at home against Dunfermline Athletic after transitioning from Kilmarnock.

Kilmarnock kick off the season on Saturday away to Highland League side Brora Rangers in not only the manager's first competitive game in charge, but the first for the nine new players he has signed so far.

The previous manager of Kilmarnock was still celebrating the retention of striker Lawrence Shankland, which hastened Penrice's departure—a player whom McInnes thinks bore a resemblance to a young Andy Robertson upon his arrival at Tynecastle.
